caveats: Descriptive scheme context, not a correction: our pre-registered gates showed team-relative rates predict WORSE than raw rates — projections use the raw numbers; this line only tells you how to read them.
Team baselines are aggregated from full rosters (steal/block baselines are minute-weighted proxies).
Percentiles are within-season (NCAA: all of D1; international: within the player's league).

Coach projections are labeled projections from the coach's previous D1 job, licensed by a pre-registered pass (COACH_PORTABILITY_PRERULE: mean ρ 0.34 across the style axes, n = 235 moves) — moderate transfer, not a measurement of this team.
wl_note: Sample caution, not a correction: this league grades below our validated weak-league line. In pre-registered backtests such samples ran optimistic on average; famous exceptions exist (this is exactly why the projection itself is unchanged).
